script: Decision: requires further review. The claimant reports a missing camera and newly splintered wood around the door lock, with visible damage corroborated by the image, supporting the forced-entry damage requirement of CA-HO4-FORCE. The required police report remains unconfirmed because the claimant does not know whether their housemate filed one. Next action: Confirm whether the housemate filed a police report and obtain it; if none exists, request that the claimant file one before reassessment.
